title: Collect every password problem
prompt: Implement `check_password(pw)` — every rule is checked, every violation is collected, the order is fixed (length, uppercase, lowercase, digit, whitespace, breach list), and non-string input returns `(False, ['must be a string'])` before any other rule runs.

tests.name: every problem, in order, every time
tests.code:
ok, problems = check_password('short')
assert problems == ['must be at least 12 characters', 'must contain an uppercase letter', 'must contain a digit']
ok, problems = check_password('correcthorsebattery')
assert problems == ['must contain an uppercase letter', 'must contain a digit', 'must not be a known breached password']
ok, problems = check_password(None)
assert problems == ['must be a string']
print('ok')
tests.hint: Collect, don't abort; ordering is part of the contract.
